scope: Current distribution inputs and latest published release; earlier investigations are archived separately.

license_decision.x264: Excluded from the release engine; built-in H.264 decoding is retained
license_decision.unicode_dfs_2016: Accepted as GPL-compatible; original notice retained in the packaged dependency inventory
license_decision.approval_scope: This records the repository license choice and reviewed compatibility decisions. It does not mark an unbuilt package as verified.

development_engine.scope: Development input only; not the engine used in release packages.

release_candidate_policy.reuse: A matching CI artifact or published release package; verify source/build identity, manifest hashes and notices.
release_candidate_policy.runtime_assembly: Windows x86_64 runtime with static CRT for riina.exe; exact archive import, source-access and extracted-application checks required.
release_candidate_policy.source_access: Exact application commit and release tag, Cargo.lock, SOURCE-MANIFEST.tsv and public pinned native repositories. Do not duplicate full native or vendored source trees in download assets.

release_engine.restoration_verification: Verified 4.2.0 engine reused unchanged: archive, tag/source identity, native contract, runtime hashes, source index and notices matched; fresh package, playback and installer checks passed.

native_tests.scope: Fresh hosted integration tests and local explicit library tests use the same release-engine hash; desktop HDR checks are recorded separately, without physical calibration claims.

historical_evidence.scope: Prior development-engine investigations, failed candidates and original 0.3.0 distribution evidence; not current release state.

latest_candidate_attempt.result: Verified candidate downloads passed original-driver desktop playback, Windows HDR/color and shutdown checks, then were published unchanged.

previous_candidate_attempt.conclusion: failure in test teardown; build and native checks passed
previous_candidate_attempt.result: Saved ZIP and installer passed corrected install/reinstall/shortcut/playback/uninstall verification, local same-version upgrade and native installed playback, then were published unchanged.
